title: Cursors
description: A list of mouse cursors kinds as seen in https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/cursor and expanded with icons from Mousecape
author: PXL-UI

entries.title: Auto
entries.description: The UA will determine the cursor to display based on the current context. E.g., equivalent to text when hovering text.

entries.title: Default
entries.description: The platform-dependent default cursor. Typically an arrow.

entries.title: None
entries.description: No cursor is rendered.

entries.title: Context Menu
entries.description: A context menu is available.

entries.title: Help
entries.description: Help information is available.

entries.title: Pointer
entries.description: The cursor is a pointer that indicates a link. Typically an image of a pointing hand.

entries.title: Progress
entries.description: The program is busy in the background, but the user can still interact with the interface (in contrast to wait).

entries.title: Wait
entries.description: The program is busy, and the user can't interact with the interface (in contrast to progress). Sometimes an image of an hourglass or a watch.

entries.title: Camera
entries.description: Something is to be captured.

entries.title: Cell
entries.description: The table cell or set of cells can be selected.

entries.title: Crosshair
entries.description: Cross cursor, often used to indicate selection in a bitmap.

entries.title: Text
entries.description: The text can be selected. Typically the shape of an I-beam.

entries.title: Vertical Text
entries.description: The vertical text can be selected. Typically the shape of a sideways I-beam.

entries.title: Cell XOR
entries.description: The table cell or set of cells can be selected.

entries.title: Alias
entries.description: An alias or shortcut is to be created.

entries.title: Copy
entries.description: Something is to be copied.

entries.title: Move
entries.description: Something is to be moved.

entries.title: No Drop
entries.description: An item may not be dropped at the current location. Firefox bug 275173: On Windows and macOS, no-drop is the same as not-allowed.

entries.title: Not Allowed
entries.description: The requested action will not be carried out.

entries.title: Grab
entries.description: Something can be grabbed (dragged to be moved).

entries.title: Grabbing
entries.description: Something is being grabbed (dragged to be moved).

entries.title: Hand
entries.description: An open hand.

entries.title: All Scroll
entries.description: Something can be scrolled in any direction (panned). Firefox bug 275174: On Windows, all-scroll is the same as move.

entries.title: Col Resize
entries.description: The item/column can be resized horizontally. Often rendered as arrows pointing left and right with a vertical bar separating them.

entries.title: Row Resize
entries.description: The item/row can be resized vertically. Often rendered as arrows pointing up and down with a horizontal bar separating them.

entries.title: N Resize
entries.description: Some edge is to be moved. For example, the se-resize cursor is used when the movement starts from the south-east corner of the box. In some environments, an equivalent bidirectional resize cursor is shown. For example, n-resize and s-resize are the same as ns-resize.

entries.title: Zoom In
entries.description: Something can be zoomed (magnified) in or out.

entries.title: Zoom Out
entries.description: Something can be zoomed (magnified) in or out.

entries.title: Rotate N-E
entries.description: Rotate from North and East
